name: Exterior Stucco/EIFS Protection & Setup
intent: Ground protection, fixture masking (stucco tape — slower than standard), HVAC cover, equipment setup.
doctrine: Stucco protection. Fixture masking 7 EA/hr (slower than masonry 12 — stucco tape required on textured surface). HVAC 2.5 EA/hr (~24 min). Equipment setup at global rates: spray 12 min, roll/brush 5 min.
